name: logseq_check_links
title: Check Links
description:
Check a [[link]] pass. ok is true only if after strips back to before, brackets balance and don't nest, every ref in before is kept, and each [[term]] names exactly one page or alias.

**Can't find:** a link to the wrong page, or a name split across a ref.

after.description: before plus [[links]], at most 500 distinct terms

name: logseq_explore_context
title: Explore Context
description:
Explore one page: its blocks, related pages and references (blocks linking to it, most-linking pages first). max_* are page sizes; hasMore: send only cursor=nextCursor.

**Use when:** researching a topic with a page, or what links to it.
**Can't find:** topics with no page (logseq_find_blocks).
**Alternatives:** logseq_get_page (content only), logseq_explore_network (structure only).

page.description: Page to explore (name, alias or ISO date). Required unless cursor is given

include_temporal_context.description: Include temporal context for journal pages (default: true)

format.description: json (default), or markdown text. Markdown has block uuids only on search hits and with compact

compact.description: Block snippets and uuids, no bodies. Read one with logseq_get_block

cursor.description: Read the next page: the nextCursor of the previous result, passed alone (the arguments are in the token)

name: logseq_explore_network
title: Explore Network
description:
Explore a page's links as nodes and edges, both ways, max_depth hops, an edge per pair with a count. With to, the shortest path to another page.

**Caps:** max_nodes per call (max 500), 15 new per page; journals, roll-ups (over 30 links) last. hasMore: send only cursor=nextCursor. truncated: rules dropped pages, see warnings.
**Can't find:** unlinked pages, or page text (logseq_explore_context).

page.description: Page to start from (page name, alias or ISO date)

to.description: A second page: the shortest path of links from page to it, within max_depth, instead of the network

max_nodes.description: Page size: most pages per call, root included (default: 50, max: 500). Not with to

max_fanout.description: Maximum new pages any one page may add (default: 15, max: 100). Not with to

expand_journals.description: Expand through journal pages and roll-up pages (pages that link over 30 pages) instead of treating them as leaves (default: false). They link to almost everything, so this can flood the network. Not with to

with_snippets.description: Add to each edge of the root the first line (80 characters) of one block that makes the link (default: false: longer results). Not with to

format.description: json (default), or markdown text. Markdown has block uuids only on search hits and with compact

cursor.description: Read the next page: the nextCursor of the previous result, passed alone (the arguments are in the token)

name: logseq_explore_timeline
title: Explore Timeline
description:
Explore a page or period over time: blocks by day (group_by week or month), with summary.topConcepts. Give page (its blocks and blocks linking to it), a period (start_date + end_date, last_n days or preset), or both; a period leaves out non-journal pages. Pages of max_blocks; hasMore: send only cursor=nextCursor.

**Can't find:** text matches (logseq_find_blocks) or days with no journal.

page.description: Page to follow: its blocks and blocks linking to it, under any alias (page name, alias or ISO date)

start_date.description: Start date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20251115). Needs end_date

end_date.description: End date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20251120). Needs start_date

last_n.description: The last N calendar days, today included (whole number, 1+)

preset.description: Named period in local time; weeks run Monday to Sunday

group_by.description: Join days into weeks or months (default: one entry per day)

slim_results.description: Slim blocks (default). false returns full entities

include_content.description: false returns only per-day block counts and top-level snippets

top_concepts_limit.description: Entries in summary.topConcepts, the most-linked pages (default 10). 0 omits it

max_blocks.description: Page size: blocks across all days, nested ones counted (top-level with include_content false), default 200, max 1000

cursor.description: Read the next page: the nextCursor of the previous result, passed alone (the arguments are in the token)

name: logseq_find_blocks
title: Find Blocks
description:
Find blocks, newest first. Filters AND (one or more): text (substring, case-insensitive); page; links_to (1-5 pages; [[x]] or #x, not plain text); property + value (exact); period on journals (start_date + end_date, last_n days or preset). Pages of limit (max 500); hasMore: send only cursor=nextCursor.

**Can't find:** synonyms, stems, ranged values, or how pages connect (logseq_explore_network).

text.description: Text to find in block content (case-insensitive, literal)

page.description: Only blocks on this page and its aliases (page name, alias or ISO date)

links_to.description: Only blocks that link to every one of these pages, under any of their names: [[x]], #x and #[[x]] count, plain text does not (1 to 5 page names, aliases or ISO dates)

property.description: Block property to match (letters, digits, "-" and "_"; createdAt and created-at are equivalent). Needs value

value.description: Exact value of the property. A multi-value property matches if any one value equals it. Needs property

start_date.description: Start date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20251115). Needs end_date

end_date.description: End date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20251120). Needs start_date

last_n.description: Only blocks on journal pages in the last N calendar days, today included (whole number, 1+)

preset.description: Named period in local time; weeks run Monday to Sunday

limit.description: Page size: most results per call (default: 100, max: 500)

slim_results.description: Slim blocks (default). false returns full entities

cursor.description: Read the next page: the nextCursor of the previous result, passed alone (the arguments are in the token)

name: logseq_find_pages
title: Find Pages
description:
Find non-journal pages as { name, aliases? }. Filters AND: text (substring of name or alias); names (up to 50, exact name or alias; each gets its page, or null + closest names); property + value (page property). limit max 1000; hasMore: send only cursor=nextCursor.

**Can't find:** journals (logseq_explore_timeline) or block text (logseq_find_blocks). pages_unavailable: list unknown, not empty.

text.description: Filter pages whose name or alias contains this text (case-insensitive)

names.description: Page names or aliases to look up exactly, ignoring case (1 to 50)

property.description: Page property to match (letters, digits, "-" and "_"; createdAt and created-at are equivalent). Needs value

value.description: Exact value of the property. A multi-value property matches if any one value equals it. Needs property

limit.description: Page size: most pages per call (default: 200, max: 1000)

format.description: json (default), or toon text: a list's keys once, not on every row

cursor.description: Read the next page: the nextCursor of the previous result, passed alone (the arguments are in the token)

name: logseq_get_block
title: Get Block
description:
Get one block by UUID, optionally with its children (hasMore: send only cursor=nextCursor). UUIDs come from other results and from ((uuid)) refs in content.

**Can't find:** blocks by text (logseq_find_blocks) or by numeric id. For a whole page use logseq_get_page.

uuid.description: UUID of the block to retrieve

format.description: json (default), or markdown text. Markdown has block uuids only on search hits and with compact

cursor.description: Read the next page: the nextCursor of the previous result, passed alone (the arguments are in the token)

name: logseq_get_current
title: Get Current Context
description:
Get what the user is looking at in LogSeq right now: the open page, the block being edited, and any selected blocks.

**Use when:** the user says "this page", "this block" or "what I'm looking at" without naming it. Then pass the page name to logseq_explore_context or logseq_get_page.

**Can't find:** anything not open right now. Returns page: null with a message when no page is open.

name: logseq_get_graph
title: Get Graph Info
description:
Get the connected graph's name and filesystem path.

**Use when:** confirming which graph is attached or debugging paths.
**Can't find:** anything about content. See logseq_find_pages and logseq_explore_context.

name: logseq_get_page
title: Get Page
description:
Get a page by name (case-insensitive). detail: page (default), full (adds its blocks) or outline (top-level blocks: uuid, first line, child count). hasMore: send only cursor=nextCursor.

**Use when:** you know the page name.
**Can't find:** pages by keyword (logseq_find_blocks, logseq_find_pages).
**Alternatives:** logseq_explore_context adds related pages and what links here.

page.description: Page name, alias, or ISO date (2025-01-01) for a journal

detail.description: page (default): the page itself. full: adds its blocks, nested. outline: top-level blocks as uuid, first line and child count

resolve_refs.description: Add resolvedContent/resolvedRefs for ((uuid)) refs and {{embed}}s (depth 2). Not for outline

format.description: json (default). markdown for page and full, toon for outline

cursor.description: Read the next page: the nextCursor of the previous result, passed alone (the arguments are in the token)
